list.query: SELECT gc_name AS __text, gc_rec_ID AS __value FROM reporting.globalcollection ORDER BY gc_name

list.name: cause
list.label: Alarm Cause (filter)
list.description: Substring match. Use 'or' for any term (e.g. CDP or DEVICE), 'and' for all terms (e.g. CDP and DUPLEX). Blank or % = all.

list.name: devices
list.label: Devices
list.query: SELECT e.entity_name AS __text, e.current_model_key AS __value FROM reporting.entity e JOIN reporting.devicemodel dm ON dm.model_key=e.current_model_key WHERE dm.destroy_time IS NULL AND (-1 IN ($group) OR e.current_model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(ai.set_time,'1d') AS time, SUM(ai.condition_id=3) AS `Critical`, SUM(ai.condition_id=2) AS `Major`, SUM(ai.condition_id=1) AS `Minor`, SUM(ai.condition_id=4) AS `Maintenance` FROM reporting.alarminfo ai JOIN reporting.alarmtitle atf ON atf.alarm_title_id=ai.alarm_title_id WHERE ai.condition_id IN ($condition) AND ( TRIM('$cause') IN ('','%') OR ( LOWER(CONCAT(' ',TRIM('$cause'),' ')) LIKE '% and %' AND atf.title LIKE CONCAT('%',SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(LOWER('$cause'),' and ',1),' and ',-1),'%') AND atf.title LIKE CONCAT('%',SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(LOWER('$cause'),' and ',2),' and ',-1),'%') AND atf.title LIKE CONCAT('%',SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(LOWER('$cause'),' and ',3),' and ',-1),'%') AND atf.title LIKE CONCAT('%',SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(LOWER('$cause'),' and ',4),' and ',-1),'%') ) OR ( LOWER(CONCAT(' ',TRIM('$cause'),' ')) NOT LIKE '% and %' AND LOWER(CONCAT(' ',TRIM('$cause'),' ')) LIKE '% or %' AND ( atf.title LIKE CONCAT('%',SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(LOWER('$cause'),' or ',1),' or ',-1),'%') OR atf.title LIKE CONCAT('%',SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(LOWER('$cause'),' or ',2),' or ',-1),'%') OR atf.title LIKE CONCAT('%',SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(LOWER('$cause'),' or ',3),' or ',-1),'%') OR atf.title LIKE CONCAT('%',SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(LOWER('$cause'),' or ',4),' or ',-1),'%') ) ) OR ( LOWER(CONCAT(' ',TRIM('$cause'),' ')) NOT LIKE '% and %' AND LOWER(CONCAT(' ',TRIM('$cause'),' ')) NOT LIKE '% or %' AND atf.title LIKE CONCAT('%','$cause','%') ) ) AND (-1 IN ($group) OR ai.model_key IN (SELECT model_key FROM reporting.gcmodel WHERE gc_rec_ID IN ($group))) AND (-1 IN ($devices) OR ai.model_key IN ($devices)) AND (ai.clear_time IS NULL OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ai.set_time, ai.clear_time) > $minDuration) AND $__timeFilter(ai.set_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
